title: 第13章 怪物第14章 利用
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
商城里三个锁定的页面有一个已经解锁。
石泉水没有急着看解锁的页面，从第一个开始慢慢看起。
“延寿丹，有百年，千年，万年.....我靠，万年延寿丹，这也太逆天了。吃一粒就能增加一万年寿命？”
再一看价格，惊得眼珠子都要掉下来了。
“3000万积分，你要我命啊！”
价格惊人是惊人，但也发现了一些奇特的地方，比如千年延寿丹，背景颜色是紫色，万年的则是金色。
别的都只是白色。
再往下看，他直接忽视了绝大多数的白色丹药。
“五圣丹，紫色，售价1600万，能提高天赋。每服用......一粒，能提高1点天赋，上限是20粒。”
“什么玩意，1粒就要1600万，才提高1点，狗都不要的东西。”
“你这个白痴，这1点天赋，你以为很少吗？”
萝莉还没有走，不过变回了黑猫在四周踱步。
“难道不是吗？”
“你觉得卖1600万的是垃圾吗？这1点天赋，能提高修士修炼速度。1点的天赋，修炼速度就是以前的10倍，20粒你觉得是多少？傻子！”
萝莉仰起头嗅了嗅鼻子，似乎发现了不一样的气味，瞳孔瞬间放大。
“这价格也不过是因为你是新手期，才打折，过段时间，你就知道你现在不买就有多后悔。”
后悔？
石泉水看看只有500万积分，想一口气买，现实也不允许啊。
“等等，你说提高修炼速度，我好像用不着吧？”
“理论上说用不着，但你毕竟可以修炼，机甲提升，你本身修为提升，想想是不是觉得很刺激？。

石泉水想想似乎有道理，机甲毕竟需要人去战斗，如果本身修为能提升，再加上机甲的提升的属性，或许.....
萝莉左前肢变回手了手，手一抖，法杖便出现在手中。
她轻轻挥动法杖，商城界面切换到了刚解锁的页面。
“这.....这......”
满屏都是刺目的红色配上亮瞎眼的光芒，不用想就知道品质比那什么万年延寿丹还要高。
可仔细一看价格，也不过千万之下。
低的离谱。
“萝莉，这些是什么？为何看起来很厉害的样子？”
石泉水侧过头，往四周看了一圈也没找到萝莉，也没放在心上。
继续看下去。
“万象仙诀上部！”
仙诀？
上部？
我靠，我记得只要功法带上个仙字的，都是绝顶功法。
“售价100万。”
点开注释：修炼此功，需同时修炼上下部，修为方可一日千里，若只修上部，前期修炼会异常迅速，但至金丹期后，修炼速度会异常艰难。
content_en:
One of the three locked pages in the mall has been unlocked.
Shi Quanshui didn't rush to look at the unlocked pages, and started reading slowly from the first one.
"The life-extending pill lasts for hundreds, thousands, ten thousand years... Holy shit, the ten-thousand-year life-extending pill is so outrageous. Can you add 10,000 years to your life by eating just one pill?"
When I looked at the price again, I was so shocked that my eyes almost dropped.
"30 million points, you want my life!"
The price is astonishing, but I also found some peculiar features, such as the Millennium Life Extension Pill, the background color is purple, and the ten thousand year pill is gold.
Everything else is just white.
Looking further down, he directly ignored most of the white pills.
"Five Holy Pills, purple, priced at 16 million, can improve talents. Every time you take... one pill, you can increase your talents by 1 point. The upper limit is 20 pills."
"What the hell? One pill costs 16 million, just one point higher. It's something even a dog doesn't want."
"You idiot, do you think this talent is very little?"
Loli hasn't left yet, but has transformed into a black cat and is pacing around.
"Isn't it?"
"Do you think those selling for 16 million are rubbish? This 1 point of talent can increase the monk's cultivation speed. With 1 point of talent, the cultivation speed is 10 times that of before. How much do you think 20 pills are? Idiot!"
Loli raised her head and sniffed her nose. She seemed to have discovered a different smell, and her pupils instantly dilated.
"The price is only discounted because you are a novice. After a while, you will know how much you will regret if you don't buy it now."
Regret?
Seeing that Shi Quan Shui only had 5 million points, he wanted to buy it all at once, but reality didn’t allow it.
"Wait, you said to increase the speed of cultivation, I don't think I need it, right?"
"Theoretically, it's not necessary, but after all, you can practice. The mecha will be improved, and your own cultivation will be improved. Isn't it exciting to think about it?"
Shi Quanshui thought about it and it seemed reasonable. After all, mechas need people to fight. If their own cultivation can be improved, coupled with the improved attributes of mechas, maybe...
Loli's left forelimb turned back into a hand, and with a shake of her hand, the staff appeared in her hand.
She waved her staff gently, and the mall interface switched to the page she had just unlocked.
"This...this..."
The entire screen is filled with dazzling red and blinding light. It doesn’t take much thinking to know that the quality is higher than that of the Ten Thousand Years of Life Extension Pill.
But if you take a closer look at the price, it's only less than 10 million.
Ridiculously low.
"Lori, what are these? Why do you look so powerful? "
Shi Quanshui turned his head and looked around but couldn't find Loli and didn't take it to heart.
Keep reading.
"The upper part of the Wanxiang Immortal Technique! "
Immortal secret?
Upper part?
Damn it, I remember that any skill with the word "xian" in it is considered a top skill.
"The price is 1 million. "
Click to open the note: To practice this skill, you need to practice the upper and lower parts at the same time, so that you can practice a thousand miles. If you only practice the upper part, the early practice will be extremely fast, but after the golden elixir stage, the cultivation speed will be extremely difficult.
